comparison.objective: Place roof slates on both gable faces so upper courses overlap lower ones in the water-shedding direction.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial reasoning and ordered overlapping placement rather than tool impact and precision fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Each face earns credit when its upper slate overlaps its lower slate; exact overlap thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is inferring face-dependent installation order, not force-controlled separation and recovery of metal tangs.
